lines.text: Hezekiah became king at twenty-five, reigned twenty-nine years, and in his first month opened and repaired the temple doors.
Hezekiah gathered the priests and Levites in the square on the east side and told the Levites to consecrate themselves.
The priests cleansed the temple, and the Levites carried the unclean things out to the Valley of Elah.
They brought twelve bulls, rams, lambs, and goats as a sin offering, and the priests splattered blood on the altar.
The Levites helped skin the offerings because priests were too few, and the people rejoiced at what God had prepared.
